Al Kanz - Capture of Immediate Relatives Information
Hi,
For you and your immediate relatives to participate in Al Kanz staff draws, staff members must ensure that their immediate relatives' information is up to date. Please provide the details of your immediate relatives in the form below.
Please note that your immediate relative will not be eligible for Al Kanz Staff draws if you are in your probation period or notice period.
You can access to page to amend any entry you have made or to add a new relative or to delete an entry.
“Immediate Relatives” are defined as:
Father Mother Son Daughter Wife Husband
If your Immediate Relative already maintains an account with ila, please provide the same Mobile Number used for opening ila Jordan account.
Please inform your immediate relatives that you have shared their information with ila Jordan for the purpose of including them in Al Kanz Staff Draws. Their personal data will be managed as per the Bank's privacy policy. Immediate Relatives who are below 18 years old shall not be added to the list. However, you are required to update the list when an Immediate Relative becomes18 years old.
Link to Update the information: Click Here
